cases.criterion: A fresh ordinary snapshot can perform its actual local work without prior Village wages or biography; loaded prior lives retain their beginning.
A household/support start has real people and actual care/access; starting relation grants no omniscient knowledge or loyalty.
A learned method and a transferred source are separate; full source with supporting body executes, instruction without required source does not.
Issued stock can be used only by actual custody/permission; witness remembers the actual report; repeated claim cannot duplicate stock or pay.
An ordinary supply contribution changes a real downstream service; exceptional transport/production can exceed ordinary output and changes supply/demand.
A hidden ability affects only an observer with an actual channel; a communicated supported report changes a later response without sharing full private state.
A source-qualified target effect changes real material/body/custody; invalid target, interruption and source loss produce exact declared consequences, not invented universal costs.
Natural events proceed from valid causes under abstention; removing a material cause changes dependent results while remote intact causes continue.
Before/during/after snapshots bind appropriate surviving people/resources/access; past source events are prior causes, not earned player deeds.
Counterpart recognition uses witnessed identity/history; two histories never share actor memories merely because their definitions share a name.
An exported unique item and external recipient remain consistent across rollback; a local archived resume cannot clone that item or silently erase external history.
Model forecast, actual future sight and practice simulation retain distinct fidelity/knowledge promises; their UI and effects do not mislabel them.
Device/furniture acquisition changes the actual function consumer; removal stops only the contribution; quiet craft effects preserve usable information with effects off.
A limited-body/system-host start has viable legal actions and independent supporter/host means; stage/host transition retains actual identity and sources.
Leaving and returning resumes the selected local absence policy and saved instance; missing/restored pack cannot pay twice or reroll entry.
Strong show-of-power, quiet mastery, static/plain/copy and off forms expose the same supported impression; private author data never enters report/tooltip fixtures.
